label: Horizontal Ticker
purpose: Scrolling content ticker that moves horizontally with text, images, or videos
_notes: Horizontal ticker scrolls content horizontally. Can include text, images, or videos. Great for marquee-style announcements or featured content. CRITICAL: Add 8-10 blocks minimum for smooth scrolling. EACH text block MUST have UNIQUE, DIFFERENT content - DO NOT repeat the same text multiple times. Examples: 'Free Shipping', 'Money-Back Guarantee', 'Trusted by 10,000+ customers', 'Secure Checkout', '24/7 Support', 'Made with Premium Materials', 'Eco-Friendly Packaging', 'Fast Delivery'.
